page.overview:
Who is Reece Jones?

Reece Jones was a police motorcyclist and the son of Elwyn Jones, Member of Parliament and one of the fiercest critics of Action Force.

Elwyn Jones was regularly critical of Action Force in both the House of Commons and in the media. When Action Force blundered into a set-up and attacked an oil rig legally owned by Destro and were captured Jones used the incident to discredit the team in the public eye.

Despite this Action Force continued to undertake a few covert operations. In one of them they prevented Cobra from kidnapping the first ever ambassador for Ishmali to the United Kingdom in order to discredit the west and make it easier to purchase oil. In the process a police motorcyclist was captured by Cobra and he turned out to be Jones's son Reece. Reece was rescued by Action Force and when his father was asked about Action Force by the media he simply stated "No comment." Action Force were subsequently reinstated.
